n0e100a5dd8.headline: Zipmex Asia Announces Partnership with Visa in Asia Pacific
n0e100a5dd8.summary: Zipmex Asia has partnered with Visa to create a new connection between digital currencies and the payment network in the Asia Pacific region.
n0e100a5dd8.why: Partnerships between crypto platforms and major payment networks like Visa facilitate broader adoption of digital currencies in mainstream payments.
